author: reactive-end
summary: The no-swallowed-errors rule is implemented for TS/JS, PHP, Kotlin, Dart, Python and Rust, with 5 unit tests and 8 new benchmark cases. The 2 former gaps are now caught: 40 cases, 5 caught, 0 false positives. Calibration on local repos found 1 hit in Anvil (daemon accept loop), 89 in Fliiper, 37 in Orbit Labs, 53 in ElMio and 8 in Catclysm. Almost all are comment-only catches, some legitimately intentional and some real slop.
blocker: User decision: block every catch without code (comment-only ignores need anvil-allow) everywhere in changed files, or only in newly added lines.
